candidates.single-repeat: Use repeat 0's frozen decoder and transition matrix.
candidates.pooled-repeats: Pool transition counts within each training repeat. Use one matrix over the whole score region.
candidates.matched-time-block: Pool transition counts within matching quarters of the training repeats. Forecast each score quarter with its matching matrix.
candidates.local-prefix: Use the same frozen decoder and estimate a matrix from the first quarter of the new repeat. Forecast the remaining quarters without updating.

criterion: Keep the decoder frozen and compare every candidate on the same disjoint score windows. Within each held repeat, average the three score-quarter forecasts by starting-label window count. A candidate qualifies an observable and starting label only if every reserved repeat and all four grids meet the one-percentage-point cutoff. Report mean and worst absolute errors. Compute transition estimates from held score quarters only for diagnosis and never for forecasting.
